sections.section_title: DCMIPP Pipex crop window size register (DCMIPP_PxCRSZR)
sections.text_helper: Section 39.14.69 "DCMIPP Pipex crop window size register (DCMIPP_PxCRSZR)" in chapter 39 (Digital camera interface pixel pipeline (DCMIPP)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 1950.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x908 + 0x400 * (x - 1), (x = 1 to 2)
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Bit 31 ENABLE:
0: Bypass, all pixels are transmitted through (no need to set any start and size values)
1: Enable, only the rectangle defined by VSIZE, HSIZE, VSTART, HSTART is transmitted.
Bits 30:28 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 27:16 VSIZE[11:0]: Vertical size, from 0 to 4094 pixels high. If the value is maintained at 0 when
enabling the crop thanks to the ENABLE bit, the value is forced internally at 0xFFE, which is
the maximum value.
Bits 15:12 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 11:0 HSIZE[11:0]: Horizontal size, from 0 to 4094 pixels wide. If the value is maintained at 0 when
enabling the crop by means of the ENABLE bit, the value is forced internally at 0xFFE, which
is the maximum value.
